text: Added JobObservation.stateExpressionTruncated with a false default and explicit additive agent-wire handling. Squeue parsing now propagates ReportedState.truncated, and reportOf correctly parses a trailing '+' in the first array-valued state expression while retaining later flag tokens. Added a provenance-pinned synthetic fixture contrasting CANCELLED+ with CANCELLED, exact digest/size checks, legacy missing-field decode coverage, and generator-strength coverage. Verified core/test, cli/test, protocol/test, ssh/test, agent/test, and scalafmtCheckAll.
